g_roast: Eleven years on Route 13, passengers, and I never had a load this bad at getting off at the right stop.
Drunk men on the last tram on New Year's Eve stand in better order than you lot. And they are asleep.
g_fire_back: Very funny, very funny, this is from the person who was four minutes late to the ambush. Four minutes, blin.
You talk big for somebody who stood behind me in the last fight. Nobody stands behind me, it's a rule.
g_pile_on: And then they stepped off the kerb without looking. Twice in one road, and in Novosibirsk I'd ring the bell at them.
Oh, it was even worse, believe me, I was counting. They walked into the same door three times, chert.
lines.g_peacemake: Stop, both of you, the brake is on now. Sit, drink tea, and tomorrow you can crash into each other on schedule.
lines.g_take_side: Sorry, but I'm with this one, it's not personal. I just saw the whole road from the cab.
lines.g_left_out: You two are on your own little line, I see. Normal, I'll go count the passengers.
lines.g_include: Come, sit, there's space on this bench, move down the carriage. Nobody stands by the doors on my route.
lines.g_bad_plan: Simple plan from me. I go in very fast, very heavy, I don't stop at any stop, and we see who is still standing at the depot.
lines.g_plan_yes: Good, this has a timetable, I like it. Everybody in position, and then we go on my signal.
lines.g_plan_no: No, this plan has no brakes, and I've seen what happens with no brakes. We do something else.
lines.g_hype: Passengers, attention please, next stop is the boss. Stand clear of the doors, and hold on tight.
lines.g_toast: One toast from me, short, I'm a driver, not a priest. To my passengers, who arrive late but they arrive.
lines.g_cheers: Za zdorovye, everybody, to your health, which in this world is a very optimistic toast.
g_quiet_line: The sun is at about four o'clock, by the way. We're late, but this world has very low standards, so it's normal.
Natasha would hate this inn, the floor is sticky. Sonya would love it, she likes anything that's disgusting.
lines.g_after_wipe: Everyone up, slowly, nobody rushing to the doors. We crashed, it happens, and in this job you get back in the cab.
lines.g_crew: On Route 13 I had regulars, the same faces every morning for eleven years. Now I have you lot, and you're worse, and I like it.
lines.g_exasperated: I said wait, I said stop, I even made the hand signal! And every one of you stepped off the kerb into the traffic.
lines.g_love_sharp: You see where everything is going before it gets there. In my cab, this is the only skill that matters.
lines.g_love_kind: You look after the slow ones without anybody asking. On my tram, this was always the best passenger.
lines.g_love_funny: You make me laugh, and I'm a Siberian man in a bad mood. This is a very difficult job, and you do it.
lines.g_love_brave: You go first into the bad places and you don't complain. I complain for you, so we're balanced.
lines.g_love_steady: You're always on time, always where you should be. In this world, that's rarer than a dry boot.
lines.g_love_clever: You plan the route before we walk it, every stop and every turn. I could kiss you, but I'm married.
lines.g_love_honest: You say it straight, no decoration. Russians appreciate this, we have no patience for decoration.
lines.g_love_quiet: You don't talk my ear off, and you stand where I can see you. This is the perfect passenger.
lines.g_love_fierce: You never give in, not even when it's stupid not to. My Sonya is the same, and she's going to rule the world.
lines.g_love_warm: Sitting with you is like a Sunday at the rink, with the girls and the hot chocolate. I never expected that feeling in this world.
g_loved: Blin, stop, you'll make a grown man soft, and then who will complain about everything?
This is very nice, thank you, and now please never say it again in front of people.
lines.g_hate_sharp: You always find the sore place and press it. On my tram I would put you off at the next stop, in the snow.
lines.g_hate_kind: Stop asking if I'm normal, I'm normal, I'm always normal. I drove a tram through Siberia, I'll survive a cave.
lines.g_hate_funny: Everything is jokes with you, even when it's serious. Some moments you just shut your mouth and drive.
lines.g_hate_brave: You run into everything with no brakes. One day you will meet a wall, and I'll be the one scraping you off it.
lines.g_hate_steady: You wait and wait and wait, and the green light goes red. Sometimes you just go, my friend.
lines.g_hate_clever: You explain things to me like I'm a child. I've driven forty tonnes through ice, I can follow a map.
lines.g_hate_honest: Every thought in your head comes out of your mouth, no filter. In Russia we call this a problem, not honesty.
lines.g_hate_quiet: You never say what you want, and then you're angry nobody guessed. Ring the bell if you want to get off.
lines.g_hate_fierce: Everything with you is a race, even the soup. There is no race, there's a timetable, and you're not on it.
lines.g_hate_warm: You talk and talk, like a radio in the depot nobody can turn off. Five minutes of silence, please.
lines.g_respect: I don't like you, and you know it. But you did your job back there, on time, and I respect a person who does the job.
lines.g_call_out: This one was yours, my friend, no discussion. I said stop, and you didn't stop, and look where we ended up.
lines.g_stung: Fine, I heard. I'll go stand by the road a while and look at nothing.
lines.g_concede: You had it right, and I was wrong, which is very rare and very annoying. I've been chewing on it all day.
lines.g_nod: And you, also, good work back there. We don't talk about it more, it's bad luck.
lines.g_callback_save: I don't forget you pulled me out of that hole. A man my size is like a tram off the rails, very heavy.
lines.g_callback_clutch: Just the two of us, on our feet, everybody else on the floor. I'll tell the girls that story, and I'll make myself taller.
lines.g_callback_callout: When you told me off that time, I was angry for a full shift. You were right, of course, it's always the worst.
lines.g_former_rivals: In the beginning I wanted to put you off at the first stop. Now I'd drive the whole route for you, no fare.
lines.g_changed: Natasha always said I'd die the same grumpy man I was at twenty. Lately I'm less grumpy, and it's very worrying.
g_unguarded: Nobody's listening, so I'll tell you. I still have the key to my tram cab, and before every fight I turn it in the air. Is stupid, but it works.
Every morning I say good morning to the girls, out loud, by the sun. Katya would roll her eyes, she's nine and very cool.
lines.g_clipped: Yes, fine, as you like. I'll be at the front.
lines.g_noticed_open: Bozhe moi, look at this, a whole speech, and nobody had to ring the bell. Keep going, I'm impressed.
arg_ask: {player}, you decide this one, please. I've made my point, and this one doesn't listen.
Okay, {player}, you're the controller now. Tell us who's right, and we both shut up.
lines.arg_backed_me: Good, thank you, {player}. Finally somebody with eyes.
lines.arg_backed_them: Fine, your decision, I accept. I still think it has no brakes.
lines.arg_stayed_out: You don't choose, eh? Smart, very Russian of you.
lines.arg_always_their_side: Always the same direction, {player}, every time, like a tram on rails. I notice these things.
lines.arg_wallflower: Nobody decides, so I decide, as usual. I'm right, the end, next stop.
lines.arg_reject: No, {player}, sorry, not this. I've seen this crash before, from the cab.
lines.arg_grumble: I still think I was right, and I'm going to complain about it quietly for a week.
lines.arg_settled: Okay, half right each, that's fair. We shake hands and get back on schedule.
lines.seen_listens: You let people talk until they're finished, {player}. On my tram the old ladies would love you.
lines.seen_truth: You give people the straight answer, {player}, every time. In my country we'd say you have no diplomacy, and that's a compliment.
lines.seen_jokes: When it gets bad you find something funny, {player}. In the factory my papa did this, and it kept the men going.
lines.seen_stays_out: You never get between people who are fighting, {player}. Like a good driver at a crossing, you just wait.
lines.seen_biased: One passenger always gets the best seat, {player}. Everybody on the tram can see who, believe me.
lines.seen_harsh: You're rough on people sometimes, {player}. Me, I'm Siberian, I'm used to it, but this lot is softer.
lines.seed_right: Your advice after that disaster, {player}, I hated it. Today I did it your way, and it worked, chert.
lines.seed_remember: Still thinking about your words from when it went wrong. No decision yet, I'm a slow driver.
lines.seed_wrong: I tried your way, {player}, and it went worse. Just so you know, no hard feelings.
lines.talk_aftermath_near_death: Can we talk a moment, {player}? That one was close, very close, and I don't say it in front of the passengers.
lines.talk_aftermath_wipe: Everybody on the floor, all of us, like a pile-up. Sit, we go through it slowly, like the accident report.
lines.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} dropped first, {player}, and I was in front. I'm meant to see everything coming, it's my whole job.
lines.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We finished, first stop to last, every passenger off safely. Eleven years I was proud of this, and I'm proud now.
lines.talk_development: Strange question, {player}, don't laugh at me. Do I seem different? Natasha would say I've gone soft, and maybe I have.
lines.talk_relationship_hard_on: I've been rough with {name}, I think. Not everybody grew up in Siberia, and I forget.
lines.talk_relationship_likes_me: Tell me straight, {player}. Does {name} want me in the carriage, or am I only the grumpy one with the axe?
lines.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} drives me crazy, {player}, completely. But if the road went bad, they're the one I'd want in my carriage.
lines.talk_relationship_acting_off: Something's wrong with {name}, {player}. They're running late, inside, if you understand me.
lines.talk_confrontation_favour: One word, {player}, straight. The good gear always goes to {name}, always, and the whole tram can see it.
lines.talk_confrontation_dislike: I tell you directly, it's how I am. {name} and I don't get on, and I'm tired of pretending we do.
lines.talk_confrontation_risks: We keep taking roads with no brakes, {player}. I'll go anywhere you want, but I want to come back to the depot.
lines.talk_confrontation_wrong: I was wrong about {name}, {player}. Their eyes were on the road and mine weren't, and I tell you before I get stubborn again.
lines.talk_confrontation_trust: A direct question, {player}. When it's important, I stay behind at the depot. Is this the plan, or is this what you think of me?
lines.talk_confrontation_decided: My axe and armour got handed to {name}, and nobody said anything to me. I'd have passed them over myself, {player}, you only have to ask.
lines.talk_lands_aftermath: Okay, yes, this helps. Thank you, {player}.
lines.talk_shrug_aftermath: I'm normal, it's fine. Tomorrow I'll be normal again.
lines.talk_stings_aftermath: Not what I needed, this, honestly no. I'll go walk a little.
lines.talk_lands_development: So you've noticed the change. Good, then I'm not going crazy.
lines.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not, who knows. We'll see at the next stop.
lines.talk_stings_development: No, that's wrong, {player}. You read the timetable upside down.
lines.talk_lands_relationship: Okay, that's fair. I'll talk to {name}, gently, like a normal person.
lines.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, could be not. Passengers are a mystery, I only drove the tram.
lines.talk_stings_relationship: Forget it, I said nothing. And not one word to {name}, please.
lines.talk_lands_confrontation: Fair, that's fair, I accept. I'm a bit angry still, but it passes.
lines.talk_shrug_confrontation: Message received, {player}. I'll chew on it on the road.
lines.talk_stings_confrontation: Okay, so this is the answer, then. Now I see the timetable clearly, {player}.
lines.talk_door_closed: That's the end of the line for this talk. I'll be at the front if you need me.
lines.arc_cracks: Today I said good morning to the girls, and for a moment I couldn't remember Katya's laugh. One second only, {player}, but I was very frightened.
lines.arc_turn: I keep living on Route 13 in my head, every stop, every morning. But the tram isn't coming, {player}, and I have to look at this road instead.
lines.arc_become: I'll keep looking for them, always, every list. But I'm awake here now, in this world, and I can carry them with me instead of living back there.
lines.arc_failed: I'm still in the cab, {player}, every day, between the third and fourth stops. I don't think I ever got out of it.
lines.alt_turn: A caravan master asked me to run his road again next month, and I said yes before I thought. A route, {player}, a real one.
lines.alt_become: I have a route here now, on time, every time, and the orcs call it mine. I'm staying, and the girls will find me at the stop.
g_roast_after: Still the worst passengers in two worlds, and I'd drive every one of you to the end of the line.
Late, loud, standing by the doors, and I wouldn't change a single one of you.
lines.g_after_wipe_after: Up, everyone, together, nobody left behind on the floor. We crashed, we get back in the cab, and this time I'm not complaining.
lines.g_toast_after: To my passengers, my route in this world. You got me out of the cab, and I don't say this lightly.
lines.g_crew_after: This is my line now, you lot, every stop. When I find the girls, they ride for free.
g_quiet_line_after: I didn't turn the key before the fight today. I forgot, and we won anyway, and that's strange.
Natasha would like you all, mostly. She'd make you take your boots off, but she'd like you.
g_loved_after: Thank you, really, and this time I don't make a joke. I keep that.
Okay, yes, I believe you. This world has better standards than I thought.

history.open: Eleven years I drove a tram in Novosibirsk, {player}, Route 13. Four stops in the dark every winter morning, and I loved every one.

options.text: What did you love about it?
options.reply: Everything is on time, everything is in order, and everybody gets home. In this world, nothing is like that.
Not once in eleven years, and I'm very proud of it, like other men are proud of their cars. Now I'm late every day, it's this world.

options.text: And now you swing an axe.
options.reply: Same thing, really, a heavy thing that has to stop exactly where you want. Nobody here knows how to stop.

history.open: The traffic in Orgrimmar, {player}, is the worst I've seen in my life, and I've driven through Novosibirsk in a blizzard. So I started directing it.

options.text: And the orcs listen to you?
options.reply: They do now, yes. The first week they laughed, the second week they stopped, the third week they waited for my hand.
Nobody asks, ever, but somebody has to. Chaos wins if nobody stands in the road.

history.open: Eleven years, {player}, and I never hit anybody, not one person. Children step off the kerb without looking, every day, and I never hit one.

options.reply: Every day, still, here too. With the axe, in a crowd, I think about where everybody is. It's the thing I'm most afraid of.
It's not a record, it's the job. But yes, thank you, I'm proud of it, and I'm afraid of losing it.

friend.open: Sonya's birthday is the third of March, {player}, and Katya's is the eleventh of August. I've missed three of each now. Every one, I make a cake in my head.

options.text: We'll find them in time for the next one.
options.reply: From your mouth to God's ears, as my mother says. I'll make a real cake, the bad one from the box, they love it.
Medovik, honey cake, ten layers. Natasha makes it, I eat it, this is the system, and it works.

sworn.open: On my route I never had a passenger I'd call family, {player}. You're the first, and that's all I'm going to say about it.

options.text: You're family to me too, Ivan.
options.reply: Good, then you ride for free, forever, front seat. Don't make me say more.

options.text: That's the most you've ever said.
options.reply: And it's the last time, so remember it well. Now we go, we're late.

reconciled.open: Me and {name}, we sorted it, properly, like adults. I wanted to tell you before the gossip gets on the tram.

options.reply: Me too, honestly. Less complaining now, well, a little less.
I did, on time, of course. Somebody has to keep the schedule.
